Detailed Description.   With Amazon listings dating back nearly 20 years, tens

of thousands of customer reviews, and an average product rating of approximately

4.5 stars, this established men's accessories brand offers a buyer an asset base

that would be nearly impossible to recreate from scratch. Its core products are

men’s wallets and belts, sold through Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and

wholesale channels. The current owner acquired the business in 2017 at

approximately $1M in annual revenue and grew it to more than $4M.

Over the past several years, the owners shifted their focus and capital toward

other ventures. As a result, inventory was not adequately replenished and became

depleted, advertising was reduced, and the business received far less attention

than during its growth years. Approximately 50% of the SKUs are currently out of

stock, while many of the core assets remain in place, including the trademark,

Amazon Brand Registry, established marketplace accounts, supplier relationships,

and key operational resources.

The clearest near-term opportunity for a buyer is to restore inventory, resume

active listing optimization and advertising, and rebuild sales velocity across

the existing catalog. The seller estimates that approximately $75K–$100K of

additional inventory, deployed in stages, would bring the catalog back to

healthy inventory levels. The business also has approximately 10–15 new products

ready to launch.

Additional growth opportunities include expanding wholesale, developing TikTok

and other marketplaces, and growing Amazon internationally. The business also

has approximately 120 active Faire accounts that provide a foundation for

further wholesale growth.

The seller and his team have nearly a decade of experience operating and growing

the business and are committed to a thorough transition. The seller is willing

to remain actively involved for several months following the sale to help a new

owner understand the business and position it for future growth.  

 

 

Request an info packet.   The average Quiet Light listing receives 3 offers,

often within days of listing. Inquire now to get a leg up on other buyers.  

Inquire Now

https://quietlight.com/listings/13546165?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=26563

  No obligation or financial commitment.

Key Benefits.  

Nearly Two Decades of Listing History   Aged listings, with accumulated reviews

across Amazon, Walmart, and eBay, represent a foundation that new entrants

cannot easily replace.

Capital Unlocks an Established Brand   Approximately 50% of SKUs are currently

out of stock. A capitalized buyer who restocks the existing catalog steps into

an established brand with demonstrated revenue of over $4M, without launching a

single new product.

Diversified Revenue Across Five Channels   Active storefronts on Amazon US,

Canada, and the UK; Walmart; eBay; Shopify; and Faire transfer with the sale.

This multi-channel footprint would take years and significant capital to

replicate from scratch.

Trademarked and Brand Registry Enrolled   The worldwide trademark and Amazon

Brand Registry enrollment are included in the sale, providing a layer of brand

protection across all channels.

A Wholesale Channel with Room to Run   The owner believes the 120 active Faire

wholesale accounts generating approximately $100K annually at roughly 50% gross

margins are scalable to $500K annually with focus, having received minimal

attention to date.

10–15 Products Ready to Launch   New SKUs are developed, sourced, and ready to

go to market, with an overseas team and a proven listing methodology already in

place to execute.

High-Demand Niche   The seller states that 100K units sell daily in this niche

on Amazon alone. Current revenue reflects an inventory issue, not a demand

issue, while overall category volume continues to grow.

Experienced Operator Transfers with Sale   The full-time employee who manages

all marketplace operations, supplier relationships, listing management, and

customer service is expected to remain under new ownership.

What separates the company from the online-course market is that it sells

implementation delivered through a proprietary platform where the curriculum,

the supplier database, the AI tools, the progress tracking, and the customer's

coach all live in one interface rather than just offering pure information.

The business has doubled net revenue in each of the last three years entirely

bootstrapped. Customers pay in full at the point of sale, which means growth has

been self-financing, and the business operates on negative working capital.

The company is run by a full executive team spanning operations, finance,

technology, sales, and marketing. More than 140 contractors across coaching,

support, onboarding, sales, creative, and engineering are already in place, with

fulfillment capacity deliberately built ahead of demand.

The company is ready to scale through expanding marketing channels, geographic

regions, and product offerings; further monetization of existing customers; and

more.

This business has already solved the hardest problem in its category: acquiring

customers profitably and at scale. A buyer inherits an operating company

generating meaningful cash flow today, run by a management team that does not

need to be replaced, and a portfolio of growth initiatives, with the most

immediate already producing evidence rather than awaiting invention.
